recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is needed for FHIR-48389 unless OO later decides to define a formal profile or invariant for the referenced List; that was not part of the applied source change.
issue_request: FHIR-48389 requested a way to encode the radiology assertion that no relevant prior comparison exams were available. The final Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6 added DiagnosticReport.comparison (0..1 Reference(List)), specified short and long text for prior data and findings for comparison, documented that List.entry.item can be profiled to ImagingStudy, DiagnosticReport, or Observation, and clarified that DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo should not duplicate resources referenced elsewhere such as comparison.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit e6a85fac75c45701596e307987e910220386a599, 'Assert no comparison exams were available', linked from Jira as PR #3705. That commit added the DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo comment and the DiagnosticReport.comparison differential element to source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes diagnosticreport, so the DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition is in current build scope. OO Confluence minutes from 2025-09-25 and 2025-09-30 show the work group reconsidered the originally requested referenced-List constraint and settled on the final Persuasive with Modification representation. FHIR-48391 is a nearby Applied DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo patient-history issue, but it is a separate use case and does not supersede the comparison element.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already contains DiagnosticReport.comparison as 0..1 Reference(List), the requested short and definition text, the requested profiling guidance comment, and the supportingInfo clarification. List.emptyReason remains the existing mechanism for the empty referenced List that encodes no known comparison exams.

related_jiras.note: Separate Applied DiagnosticReport issue for patient history in supportingInfo; it touched nearby source but addressed a different use case and did not alter the comparison decision.
